claims.statement: Entered as no. 36 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Flower of Virtue".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Fiore di virtù. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed c. 1320 · Printed 1470s.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition

background.text: An anonymous moral bestiary of the fourteenth century, a direct source for Leonardo's animal fables and emblematic sketches.
